# SFIDM - Version 3.1

## Fixes & Improvements in v3.1
- **Short Link Auto-Resolver:** Automatically expands `pin.it`, `vm.tiktok.com`, `vt.tiktok.com`, `fb.watch`, `youtu.be`, `t.co`, and `bit.ly` short URLs before downloading.
- **Pinterest Photo & Video Support:** Automatically downloads both Pinterest video pins (`v.pinimg.com`) and high-resolution original image pins (`i.pinimg.com/originals/...`) directly from `+` or Share menu into `Downloads/SFIDM/Images` or `Videos`.
- **Dual-Channel Video Engine Update:** Tries `Nightly` and `Stable` `yt-dlp` channels automatically and displays clear status feedback.
- **Full Error Details Dialog:** Tap any failed download card to inspect or copy the complete error message.
